The Subtask Name: Identify the composer of the song "How Long Has This Been Going On?"
Step Range: 0-1
The Oracle: George Gershwin
Evidence: Planner confirms the composer is George Gershwin based on the song title; WebSurfer verifies this via DuckDuckGo search results showing the song was composed by George Gershwin.

The Subtask Name: Retrieve and analyze the place of death from Wikipedia
Step Range: 2-3
The Oracle: Los Angeles, California (or Hollywood, California)
Evidence: Planner instructs WebSurfer to open George Gershwin's Wikipedia page; WebSurfer extracts the death location as Los Angeles, California from the infobox.

The Subtask Name: Verify place of death using Britannica and resolve discrepancies
Step Range: 4-10
The Oracle: Hollywood, California (Cedars of Lebanon Hospital)
Evidence: Planner detects conflicting info between Wikipedia (LA) and Britannica (Hastings-on-Hudson, NY); WebSurfer attempts to load Britannica (timeout then success showing conflicting data); Planner decides to consult primary obituaries; WebSurfer searches for NYT obituary.

The Subtask Name: Confirm place of death using primary newspaper obituaries
Step Range: 11-20
The Oracle: Hollywood, California
Evidence: WebSurfer accesses the NYT obituary confirming death in Hollywood, CA at Cedars of Lebanon Hospital; Planner notes the discrepancy with Britannica but prioritizes the primary source; WebSurfer attempts to find LA Times obituary to corroborate but search results remain inconclusive regarding the specific LA Times page, yet the NYT evidence is sufficient for final conclusion.
